actions.name: 주소 → 좌표 (지오코딩)
actions.description: Turn a Korean address or place name into latitude and longitude

actions.name: 좌표 → 주소 (역지오코딩)
actions.description: Turn latitude and longitude back into a road-name and lot-number address

actions.name: 주소 검색 (부분 일치)
actions.description: Search addresses by fragment when the full address is unknown

actions.name: 장소 키워드 검색 (맛집·카페·역 등)
actions.description: Find places by what they are called

actions.name: 카테고리로 주변 검색 (편의점·주차장·병원 등)
actions.description: List every place of one category near a point or inside a rectangle

params.sort: accuracy(기본) 또는 distance. distance 는 중심 좌표가 있어야 함

actions.name: 좌표 → 행정구역 (시도·시군구·읍면동)
actions.description: Which administrative region a coordinate falls in, both the legal-dong and the administrative-dong answer

actions.name: 좌표계 변환 (WGS84 ↔ TM/WTM/KTM 등)
actions.description: Convert one coordinate pair between coordinate systems

params.includePath: 경로 선 좌표 포함 여부 — 지도에 그릴 때만 true (응답 대부분이 이 좌표들)

actions.name: 도보 길찾기
actions.description: Walking directions, with up to five waypoints and a route preference (BROAD_FIRST default, SHORTEST, ACCESSIBLE)

actions.name: 자전거 길찾기
actions.description: Bicycle directions, with waypoints and its own set of route preferences. Kept apart from walking because the preference values differ.

actions.name: 정적 지도 이미지 (PNG)
actions.description: Render a map as a PNG and land it in the media store, so a map can go into a document, a report or a message

params.logoPos: 카카오 로고 위치 — 이미지에 새겨져 제거 불가, 이동만 가능
params.name: 저장 파일 이름
